name: Desjardins Insurance - Desjardins Financial Security Life Assurance Company (DFS), part of Desjardins Group
ownership: Co-operative: indirect wholly owned sub of Fédération des caisses Desjardins du Québec (via Desjardins Financial Corporation); no listed equity
regulator: AMF (Québec): CARLI guideline for DFS; Desjardins Group supervised by AMF under Basel III

metrics.note: C$510.2bn at 2025-12-31. Group-level (caisses, bank-like treasury, P&C, wealth, L&H).

metrics.metric: Segment assets - Wealth Management and Life and Health Insurance
metrics.note: C$82.9bn at 2025-12-31 (Note 29 segment assets). Segment includes DFS, Desjardins Global Asset Management, Desjardins Investments, Worldsource and (from 2026-03-23) Guardian Capital. DFS standalone total assets not disclosed in Group reports.

metrics.metric: Insurance contract liabilities (Group, L&H + P&C) / segregated fund net assets
metrics.note: Insurance contract liabilities C$34.7bn; segregated fund net assets C$34.1bn (investment contracts C$30.5bn). General-account invested assets of DFS not separately disclosed.

C$122.8bn at 2025-12-31 (institutions/individuals C$29.1bn, investment funds C$93.7bn); jump reflects Guardian acquisition. AUA C$673.0bn at YE2025. DGAM alone: C$129bn AUM at 2026-03-31; DGAM + Guardian ~C$280bn AUM/AUA.

metrics.metric: Net surplus earnings - Wealth Management and L&H Insurance segment FY2025
metrics.note: FY2024 C$633mm. Insurance service result C$617mm; net insurance finance result C$498mm; other income C$2,879mm. Group surplus earnings before member dividends C$3,811mm.
Q2 2026 C$252mm (Q2 2025 C$226mm); H1 2025 C$394mm. Group surplus earnings before member dividends H1 2026 C$2,173mm.

metrics.metric: Insurance and annuity premiums - segment FY2025
metrics.note: Group insurance C$4,458mm; individual insurance C$1,301mm; annuities C$737mm (C$1,476mm in 2024). Insurance revenue (IFRS 17) C$4,395mm. Net sales of savings products C$19.5bn.
C$2,385mm at YE2025 (net of reinsurance CSM C$214mm); CSM on new sales C$90mm in 2025.

metrics.metric: Capital ratio - Desjardins Group Tier 1A / Total (Basel III, AMF)
metrics.note: Total capital ratio 26.0%; YE2025 23.7% / 26.1%. AMF minimum incl. buffers 8.0% Tier 1A. DFS/Desjardins Financial Corporation CARLI ratio not disclosed in Group reports (insurance holding deconsolidated for Group capital).
Not disclosed for DFS. Group subordinated notes C$4.81bn vs equity C$42.3bn at YE2025; Group leverage ratio reported under Basel III (see MD&A).

FSR A (Excellent), Long-Term ICR a+ (Excellent), Stable outlook - first AM Best rating assigned to DFS. Federation: DBRS AA / Fitch AA / Moody's Aa1 / S&P A+ (deposits), NVCC sub notes A (low)/A/A2/BBB+, covered bonds AAA/Aaa, all Stable (YE2025).

'More than 100 investment specialists' (DGAM site, pre-Guardian). DGAM team page lists ~85 named professionals incl. 8 fixed income, ~15 equities, 13 infra/real estate, 6 quant, SAA/LDI and 10 responsible-investment staff. Guardian adds further teams (Toronto, UK).

'More than 100 investment specialists' (DGAM site, pre-Guardian). Team page lists ~85 named professionals: 8 fixed income, ~15 equities, 13 infra/real estate, 6 quant, SAA/LDI, 10 RI. Guardian adds Toronto/UK teams.

pm_structure.summary: DFS assets managed by affiliate Desjardins Global Asset Management (DGAM, C$129bn AUM pre-Guardian; ~C$280bn AUM/AUA after the Mar-2026 C$1.67bn Guardian deal) across fixed income, equities, infra, real estate, private investment and LDI (inferred mandate).
manager_entities: Desjardins Global Asset Management Inc. (affiliate; CEO George Mavroudis; CIO Public Markets Christian Duceppe; CIO Private Markets Frédéric Angers)
Guardian Capital Group (acquired 2026-03-23; merged under DGAM)
Desjardins Investments / Desjardins Funds use external sub-advisers for retail funds
Worldsource Group (acquired 2023) - distribution, not GA management
bullets: DGAM clients include insurers and pensions; third-party profile: DGAM 'manages assets chiefly from the equity of insurance subsidiaries' (inferred DFS GA mandate)
DGAM capabilities: fixed income (>C$76bn), Canadian/global/EM equities, direct infrastructure and real estate, private investment, quant, SAA/LDI, index, RI
Group Treasury (under EVP Finance) runs funding, covered bonds, repos, securities lending; DFS runs its own rate and seg-fund hedging
DFS price-risk policy: hold the assets underlying par and seg-fund liabilities; limits by investment type, issuer, geography under a governance committee
2025 'one-time change to investment strategy': sold C$947mm FVOCI equities (gain C$225mm); insurance-held common shares C$898mm -> C$126mm

rotation_commentary.text: 2025: one-time strategy change sold C$947mm FVOCI equities held for insurance (common C$898mm -> C$126mm; prefs kept at C$885mm), gain C$225mm.
2024: L&H took losses on bond disposals and a fair-value decline on infrastructure; 2025 net insurance finance result +39.5% to C$498mm.
2026: Guardian Capital (closed 2026-03-23) adds global equity, fixed income, private wealth; DGAM+Guardian ~C$280bn AUM/AUA; Group AUM C$306bn Q2-26.
DFS hedges seg-fund and UL minimum-rate guarantees; risk-mitigation effect +C$127mm in 2025; annuity premiums halved to C$737mm as PRT volumes fell.
2026 L&H priorities: ease of business, sustainable growth, digital/data modernisation, sustainability; wealth: expand Ontario, Atlantic, West.

Insurance-held FVOCI securities C$1,083mm (prefs C$885mm) at YE2025
